homepage.hero.title.message: Infrastructure for the Romanian Electronic Identity Card

homepage.hero.subtitle.message: Verify identity, sign documents, and authenticate users with a single tap of the identity card on your phone.

homepage.feature.kyc.description.message: Read identity fields (name, CNP, date of birth), face photo, handwritten signature image, and full address from the EDATA applet — all in one NFC tap.

homepage.feature.signing.description.message: Produce a qualified ECDSA-SHA384 signature using the nonRepudiation key on the card chip. Embed directly into a PAdES/eIDAS PDF or send to your signing service.

homepage.feature.activeauth.description.message: Challenge-response verification that the chip is genuine and has not been cloned. Returns raw cryptographic proof material your backend can independently verify.
